<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. Fix one problem per PR.
Title: a Conventional Commits title in plain language, such as
"fix(web): ghost blocks no longer flicker when slicing layers".
-->

## Problem

<!-- What is broken, in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior, steps to
reproduce, and the Minecraft, Litematica and mod versions where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes it. If the change touches more than one part (client,
server, web app, game test), say why each part is needed for this fix. -->

## Scope

<!-- Link the issue: "Fixes #123". For a small, obvious bug, say why it needs
no issue. For a feature, link the issue where the maintainer agreed to it. -->

## Verification

<!-- What you ran or tried, and what you saw. "Tests pass" alone is not enough.
- Web viewer changes: before and after screenshots, plus a short video for
  motion, timing or camera changes. Upload them here; don't commit them.
- Multiplayer changes: say whether you tested on a dedicated server with two
  or more clients.
- Shader changes: name the packs you tried.
State anything you could not check. -->

<!-- If you used an AI agent, name the model and harness here. -->
